global.criterion: Rounded sculpted cartoon3D, credible maize leaf and soil materials, warm off-white scene, complete unclipped objects; no people.
No generated text, letters, numbers, icons or answer badges.
Plants visibly maize: narrow elongated blades and parallel venation, not oval broadleaf/dicot plants.

s203-reading-comparison.criterion: Exactly4separate comparison plant groups: healthy, older central-V leaf, young purple lower leaves, older yellow-margined leaf; crop and older/younger positions legible.
N-like central V at pointed tip has green margins, K-like yellow margins have green centre; they are not exchanged. No wilt used as nutrient proof.

s203-reading-magnesium.criterion: Affected long narrow maize leaf has multiple lengthwise yellow INTERVEINAL bands between visibly green parallel veins; not edge-only yellowing or one central V.
Older/lower affected leaf and healthy comparison visible; upper leaves greener.

s203-station-a.criterion: Affected leaves and their older/lower versus younger/upper position are visibly attached and legible enough to describe; compare at least one apparently healthy reference. Do not infer nutrient diagnosis from this criterion.
